name: @algorythmo/brain-cli
description: GBrain CLI dependency for Algorythmo Brain MVP (M3). Managed separately from the frontend bundle.

notes.pin-policy: ADR-0013 — pin by 40-char commit SHA, bump bi-weekly (odd ISO week Mondays) + hotfix lane for CVE/regression. Mirror of engines/algorythmo/GBRAIN_PINNED_SHA (single source of truth for bumps).
notes.runtime: GBrain is a Node.js CLI. Install via pnpm (project default) or bun: `pnpm install` in engines/algorythmo/. The gbrain binary is invoked via Open3 subprocess from Brain::Client (PR M3-2).
